rfam.description: turnip yellow mosaic virus upstream pseudo-knot (TYMV_upPK)
rfam.comment: This family represents the upstream pseudoknot structure from turnip yellow mosaic virus (TYMV_upPK) which is thought to be needed for efficient transcription as disruption of the pseudoknot structure gives rise to a 50% drop in transcription efficiency [1]. This family acts in conjunction with Rfam:RF00233 to enhance translation [2]. The structure of TYMV_upPK have being reported in PDB: 6MJ0 [3].
